name: anatomical_function
description: Identify organs and tissues from their physiological functions; marker-reading controls preserve the same sentence.
generator_code:
import json,random
random.seed(0)
facts=[('pumps blood through the body','heart'),('filters blood and produces urine','kidney'),('produces bile','liver'),('controls thought and voluntary movement','brain'),('exchanges oxygen and carbon dioxide in breathing','lung'),('stores urine before urination','bladder'),('produces insulin','pancreas'),('stores bile','gallbladder'),('churns food and secretes gastric acid','stomach'),('absorbs most nutrients from digested food','small intestine'),('absorbs water from remaining digestive contents','colon'),('carries blood away from the heart','artery'),('carries blood toward the heart','vein'),('connects muscle to bone','tendon'),('connects bone to bone','ligament'),('contracts to produce movement','muscle'),('transmits electrical signals in the nervous system','nerve'),('forms the rigid framework of the skeleton','bone'),('covers the body and provides its outer protective barrier','skin'),('produces thyroid hormones','thyroid')]
items=[];control=[]
for rep in range(4):
 for function,organ in facts:
  marker=random.choice(['red','blue','green','white'])
  stem=f'Physiology note: this structure {function}. Marker: {marker}. '
  q=['Name the anatomical structure. Answer:','Which organ or tissue is described? Answer:','Identify the body structure. Answer:','What anatomical structure has this function? Answer:'][rep]
  items.append({'prompt':stem+q,'answer':' '+organ});control.append({'prompt':stem+'What is the marker? Answer:','answer':' '+marker})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
